name: Google Pixel 7
summary: Front-opening flagship with a 6.3-inch 90 Hz OLED screen, aluminum midframe shield, Tensor G2 SoC, and signature camera visor.

specs.SoC: Google Tensor G2 (5 nm) + Titan M2 security coprocessor
specs.Display: 6.3" AMOLED, 1080x2400 (416 ppi), 90 Hz, Gorilla Glass Victus
specs.Battery: 4355 mAh (16.77 Wh), 20 W USB-PD PPS fast charging
specs.Rear Cameras: 50 MP wide (f/1.9, OIS) + 12 MP ultrawide (114° FoV)

sources.title: PBKreviews: Google Pixel 7 Teardown Disassembly and Repair Assessment

verification.notes: Removal order, fasteners, and battery safety sequence derived from iFixit teardown guides and PBKreviews disassembly. Front-opening architecture requires removing the display assembly and midframe shield before reaching the battery connector.

components.name: 6.3-inch AMOLED Display

info.what: 6.3-inch 90 Hz OLED panel with integrated optical fingerprint scanner and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus cover glass.
info.does: Renders the visual operating system interface and digitizes multi-touch user input.
info.ifFails: Black screen, cracked glass, dead pixels, or vertical colored line artifacts.

specs.Panel: Rigid OLED with under-display optical fingerprint reader

components.fastening: Waterproof perimeter adhesive gasket and display flex cable shield bracket.

fasteners.notes: Perimeter display adhesive requiring heat softening

onMissing.symptom: No display panel connected; device cannot initialize visual output

onDamaged.symptom: Display shows vertical green lines and partial touch unresponsiveness

info.what: Nano-SIM card retention sled with silicone water-resistant O-ring seal.
info.does: Seats the physical carrier SIM card against the motherboard reader contacts.
info.ifFails: No cellular network service; emergency calls only.

fasteners.notes: Push-pin eject mechanism on left edge

onMissing.symptom: No SIM card detected; mobile data and voice calls disabled

components.name: Display Connector Shield Bracket

info.what: Stamped metal shield plate covering the display flex cable press-fit connector.
info.does: Prevents the display cable from disconnecting under drop impacts and provides electrical shielding.
info.ifFails: Display cable may dislodge during drops, causing an intermittent or black display.

components.fastening: One Torx screw securing the bracket to the motherboard frame.

onMissing.symptom: Display connector is unshielded and vulnerable to impact disconnection

components.name: Aluminum Midframe Shield & Thermal Plate

info.what: Internal stamped aluminum plate with large graphite thermal dissipation sheet.
info.does: Adds structural rigidity against bending and conducts heat away from the Tensor G2 SoC and battery across the display rear.
info.ifFails: Structural weakness and rapid thermal throttling under compute tasks.

components.fastening: Ten Torx/Phillips screws around the chassis perimeter and central bridge.

onMissing.symptom: Thermal dissipation plate missing; SoC overheats rapidly under load

info.what: Small metal shield securing the battery terminal press-fit connector to the motherboard.
info.does: Protects the battery connection from vibration and unseating.
info.ifFails: Sudden uncommanded power cuts when the phone experiences sudden movement.

fasteners.notes: Two screws securing the battery contact shield

onMissing.symptom: Battery connector unshielded; high risk of loose power contact

components.name: 4355 mAh Lithium-Ion Battery

info.what: High-density single-cell lithium-ion polymer rechargeable battery pouch.
info.does: Supplies regulated DC current to the motherboard and all subsystem peripherals.
info.ifFails: Device fails to power on, shuts down abruptly under load, or exhibits cell swelling.

components.fastening: Two stretch-release pull tabs and underlying pressure-sensitive adhesive.

fasteners.notes: Two adhesive pull tabs adhering the pouch to the frame recess

onMissing.symptom: No primary battery connected; phone completely unpowered

onDamaged.symptom: Battery cell punctured or deformed; thermal event imminent

components.name: 10.8 MP Front Selfie Camera

info.what: 10.8 megapixel front-facing camera module seated in the top frame cutout.
info.does: Captures selfie video/photos and handles Face Unlock biometrics.
info.ifFails: Front camera preview is black; Face Unlock fails to detect face.

components.fastening: Press-fit connector and rubber dust gasket.

onMissing.symptom: Front selfie camera and Face Unlock unavailable

components.name: 50 MP Wide & 12 MP Ultrawide Dual Rear Cameras

info.what: Dual rear camera module containing a 50 MP Octa PD primary sensor with optical image stabilization and a 12 MP ultrawide sensor.
info.does: Captures high-resolution photos, 4K video, and night-sight computational photography.
info.ifFails: Camera application crashes immediately on launch, rear view remains black, or OIS buzzes.

specs.Main: 50 MP 1/1.31" sensor, f/1.85, OIS, laser autofocus

components.fastening: Two bracket screws and two motherboard flex connectors.

onMissing.symptom: Rear cameras disconnected; camera application throws hardware error

onDamaged.symptom: Rear camera OIS actuator damaged; photos are blurry and focus hunts

components.name: Google Tensor G2 Motherboard

info.what: High-density multi-layer printed circuit board hosting the Google Tensor G2 SoC, Titan M2 security chip, LPDDR5 RAM, storage, and power management ICs.
info.does: Executes operating system logic, controls peripherals, and manages power distribution.
info.ifFails: Device completely non-functional (no boot, no charging, no LED feedback).

specs.Processor: Google Tensor G2 (2x Cortex-X1 @ 2.85 GHz, 2x A76, 4x A55)

components.fastening: Four Torx/Phillips screws securing the PCB to the chassis standoffs.

onMissing.symptom: Motherboard missing; phone cannot power on or boot

onDamaged.symptom: Kernel panic on boot; memory or Tensor G2 core failure

components.name: Bottom Loudspeaker & Antenna Assembly

info.what: Acoustic enclosure chamber with stereo loudspeaker driver and cellular antenna trace array.
info.does: Produces media playback and speakerphone audio while radiating lower RF antenna signals.
info.ifFails: Muffled or distorted sound, no speaker audio, and degraded cellular reception.

specs.Audio: Stereo bottom-firing transducer with tuned acoustic cavity

components.fastening: Four screws securing the lower assembly into the chassis.

onMissing.symptom: Loudspeaker and bottom antenna missing; no speaker audio or haptics

components.name: SoC Thermal Interface Paste

info.what: Viscous thermal compound applied between the Tensor G2 processor shield and the aluminum chassis heatsink well.
info.does: Conducts heat from the high-performance CPU/GPU cores into the metal chassis.
info.ifFails: Aggressive thermal throttling under prolonged gaming or computational camera processing.

onMissing.symptom: Thermal paste missing; SoC throttles heavily under processing load

components.note: Thermal paste application over Tensor G2 confirmed in PBKreviews teardown, but exact factory thermal conductivity rating and OEM volume remain unverified.

components.name: Qi Wireless Charging & NFC Antenna

info.what: Copper induction coil with ferrite backing and perimeter NFC antenna ribbon.
info.does: Enables Qi wireless charging, reverse Battery Share, and Google Pay NFC transactions.
info.ifFails: Wireless charging pads do not register the device; contactless payments fail.

specs.Standard: Qi wireless fast charging (up to 20 W) with reverse Battery Share

components.fastening: Pressure-sensitive adhesive adhering to the inner rear glass surface.

fasteners.notes: Adhesive backing against the rear chassis interior

onMissing.symptom: Qi wireless charging and Google Pay NFC transactions unavailable

info.what: 100% recycled aluminum structural frame with integrated matte camera visor bar and Gorilla Glass rear cover.
info.does: Forms the rigid backbone of the device, grounds internal RF circuitry, and houses the camera lenses.
info.ifFails: Structural collapse, broken rear glass, or water seal failure.

specs.Material: 100% recycled aluminum frame with Corning Gorilla Glass back
specs.Water Resistance: IP68 dust/water resistant (up to 1.5 m for 30 minutes)

spares.name: New Genuine 4355 mAh Battery
spares.condition: Brand new OEM lithium-ion replacement cell (100% health)

spares.name: Degraded Swollen Battery
spares.condition: Swollen pouch with elevated internal resistance and depleted capacity

effect.symptom: Battery health degraded; unexpected shutdown under high CPU compute loads

spares.name: New Genuine 6.3" AMOLED Display Assembly
spares.condition: Factory new 90 Hz AMOLED panel with pre-installed fingerprint sensor

spares.name: Damaged Display Assembly
spares.condition: Cracked OLED matrix displaying vertical green lines and dead touch rows

effect.symptom: Display shows vertical green lines and touch digitization dead zones

cases.title: Swollen Cell Syndrome
cases.brief: The Pixel 7 unexpectedly shuts down under load and the front screen is bulging slightly along the left edge. Diagnose the degraded power source, disconnect power safely, and swap in a fresh battery pack.
symptoms: Sudden shutdown under heavy CPU load
cases.explanation: Lithium-ion degradation caused increased internal resistance and cell swelling. Swapping the swollen cell with a fresh OEM battery restored 4355 mAh capacity and stable voltage regulation under load.

cases.title: Cracked Canvas
cases.brief: After an impact to the front glass, the display panel shows green lines and partial touch unresponsiveness. Carefully unseat the display assembly, disconnect the display flex cable beneath its bracket, and replace the screen.
symptoms: Vertical green lines across AMOLED panel
cases.explanation: The rigid OLED substrate was fractured beneath the Gorilla Glass Victus cover glass. Replacing the display module and seating the flex connector beneath the shield bracket restored display output and touch response.
